dancing.notes: Lushes runs DJ dance nights: Freestyle Fridays with 80s and 90s freestyle and disco, and Saturday dance parties. It is 21+ after 9 PM.

description: A cocktail lounge and restaurant on Long Beach Road in Oceanside that opened in 2026. It turns into a 21-and-over nightspot with DJs after 9 PM.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's 'LIR Dance Party with Andre' on Oct 3 matches the venue's Saturday DJ parties (we found an Oct 17 listing). No Facebook page found. Size of the dance area not confirmed.
